common.tagline: The bridge between farm and buyer
common.name: Name

roles.farmerDesc: List your produce, track what sells and see what buyers need.
roles.individualDesc: Buy fresh produce for your home, straight from farms.
roles.industrialDesc: Buy in bulk for a restaurant, shop, mill or canteen, and post requirements.

landing.title: Sell what you grow. Buy from the people who grow it.
landing.body: AnnSetu connects farmers with households and businesses. Farmers keep a record of every listing and sale. Buyers order straight from the farm and pay on delivery.
landing.farmer1Title: A clean record of your stock
landing.farmer1Body: See how much of each crop is sold, waiting in orders, and still unsold.
landing.farmer2Body: Buyers post what they need. Their requests show up on your demand panel.
landing.farmer3Body: Accept, pack and deliver from your phone. Stock updates by itself.
landing.buyer1Body: Every listing shows who grew it, where, and when it was harvested.
landing.buyer2Body: Restaurants, shops and mills can post what they need and when.
landing.buyer3Body: No online payment needed. Pay the farmer in cash when the order arrives.

auth.loginBody: Sign in to your AnnSetu account.
auth.signupBody: It takes a minute. You can change your details later.
auth.confirmEmailBody: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it on this device to finish creating your account.
auth.resetBody: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way.
auth.invalidCredentials: Email or password is wrong. Check both and try again.
auth.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
auth.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first. Open the link we sent you.
auth.recoveryWaiting: Open the reset link from your email on this device to set a new password.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

onboarding.title: Set up your profile
onboarding.subtitle: This is how farmers and buyers will know you.
onboarding.locationFarmerHint: Where your farm is. Buyers see only your district and state.
onboarding.locationBuyerHint: Where you want orders delivered. You can change it at checkout.
onboarding.phoneFarmerHint: Buyers see it only on orders you've received.
onboarding.phoneBuyerHint: Farmers see it only on your orders.
onboarding.mainCropsHint: Type a crop and press Enter.
onboarding.pinRequired: Set your exact spot on the map: tap it or use your location.
onboarding.radiusHint: Usual distance you will travel to a buyer. Default {{km}} km.
onboarding.maxKmHint: Farther farms can't reach you fresh or cheaply. Default {{km}} km.

location.gpsDenied: Location access is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, or drag the pin on the map.
location.gpsUnavailable: This device couldn't find your location. Drag the pin on the map instead.
location.dragPin: Drag the pin or tap the map to set your exact spot.
location.filled: Address filled from your location. Check it and correct anything that's off.
location.lookupFailed: Couldn't look up the address. Type it in below.
location.mapLabel: Map. Drag the pin to set your location.

produce.title: My produce
produce.subtitle: Everything you've listed and where it stands.
produce.emptyBody: List your first crop so buyers can find it.
produce.name: Produce name
produce.priceHint: What a buyer pays for one {{unit}}.
produce.minOrderHint: Smallest amount one buyer can order.
produce.organicHint: Grown without chemical fertiliser or pesticide.
produce.descriptionPlaceholder: How it was grown, how it's packed, anything a buyer should know.
produce.photosHint: Up to 4 photos. Clear daylight photos sell better.
produce.archiveBody: It leaves the market. Its sales record stays in your log.
produce.unitLocked: The unit can't change once this listing has orders.
produce.notFound: This listing doesn't exist or isn't yours.
produce.itemHint: Type any name: tomato, tamatar or टमाटर.

produce.freshUntil: Shown to buyers until about {{when}}, while it can still arrive fresh.
produce.radiusHint: Leave empty to use your usual {{km}} km.

ledger.title: Stock log
ledger.subtitle: Every change to {{name}}, newest first.
ledger.correctHint: Use a minus sign to reduce, e.g. -5.
ledger.tooMuch: That's more than the {{qty}} {{unit}} still unsold.

dashboard.subtitle: Here's how your produce is doing.
dashboard.noOrdersBody: Orders show up here as soon as a buyer places one.
dashboard.noStock: List produce to see how it sells.

orders.rejectBody: The buyer will see it as rejected, and the reserved stock goes back on sale.
orders.cancelBody: The stock goes back on sale and the other side sees the order as cancelled.
orders.emptyFarmer: Orders show up here as soon as a buyer places one.
orders.reviewPlaceholder: What was good, and what could be better?
orders.transitionError: This order changed in the meantime. Refresh to see its latest status.
orders.deliveryPending: shared, set when the trip ships
orders.acceptTitle: Accept and promise a delivery time
orders.acceptBody: Buyers see this time. Delivering by it counts towards your on-time record.
orders.tripMeta: {{km}} km · {{load}} kg · the homes pay {{fee}} for delivery
orders.belowBreakEven: This trip closed at its cut-off before the homes' savings covered it: they pay {{paid}} towards the {{trip}} trip. Accept only if the trip still suits you.
orders.formingBody: Household orders wait here until together they pay for the trip, or until the cut-off.

market.title: Market
market.subtitle: Fresh produce listed directly by farmers.
market.emptyBody: Try another category or clear the search.
market.loginToBuy: Sign in as a buyer to order
market.farmerViewing: You're seeing the market as buyers see it. Farmers can't place orders.
market.notFound: This listing is no longer on sale.

cart.title: Cart
cart.splitNote_one: Items come from 1 farmer, so this becomes 1 order.
cart.splitNote_other: Items come from {{count}} farmers, so this becomes {{count}} separate orders.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.notesPlaceholder: Gate number, best time to deliver…
checkout.codBody: Pay the farmer in cash when your order arrives.
checkout.successBody_one: Your order was sent to the farmer. Follow it in My orders.
checkout.successBody_other: {{count}} orders were sent to farmers. Follow them in My orders.
checkout.insufficient: {{name}} has only {{qty}} left. Lower the quantity and try again.
checkout.belowMin: {{name}} needs a bigger order. Check the minimum and try again.
checkout.unavailable: {{name}} is no longer on sale. Remove it from your cart.
checkout.ownProduce: You can't order your own produce.
checkout.needPin: Set your delivery spot on the map: tap it or use your location.
checkout.oneTrip: One trip of {{km}} km there and back, paid to the farmer with the order.
checkout.sharedWaiting: Shared with other homes in your PIN code: a {{km}} km trip costing {{trip}} in all. Your share falls as neighbours join, and is never more than what you save against the shop ({{max}}).
checkout.sharedShipsNow: Your order completes a shared {{km}} km trip ({{trip}} in all). It goes to the farmer now.
checkout.pooledNote_one: 1 order is waiting to share a trip with neighbours.
checkout.pooledNote_other: {{count}} orders are waiting to share trips with neighbours.

rate.title: Suggested price
rate.noPrices: No mandi or shop price is known for this item yet, so no price can be suggested.
rate.sampleWarning: Sample prices, not live market data. The suggestion becomes real once the mandi price feed runs.
rate.how: How this is worked out (per base unit)
rate.noRoom: One trip of {{load}} {{unit}} can't pay for itself at any price. The smallest worthwhile load is {{breakEven}} {{unit}}; household orders are pooled until they reach it.

demo.banner: Demo mode: everything you do is saved in this browser only. The nearby farms and buyers marked as demo are made up.

demo.failed: The demo database couldn't start. Check your internet connection and reload the page.
demo.noEmailReset: Demo mode sends no emails, so passwords can't be reset here. Create a new account instead; it takes a minute.
